memory.summary:
On January 1st, Leo, Noor, and Peter catch up at home, discussing updates on the AI music project. Leo and Noor make plans to meet at Caroline's Café the next day at 3 PM, and they both express excitement about the upcoming creative collaboration, discussing inviting Peter to join them. During the conversation, they also learn that Peter has a meeting discussing updates and ideas for the AI project at Caroline's Café on the 5th at 4 PM, and he invites Leo to join. Leo agrees and suggests a potential musical collaboration between them.

Caroline, who expresses her involvement in the project, also agrees to meet the following day. Leo later talks to Caroline at the museum, and she proposes a collaboration on her AI-music fusion project. Leo agrees to discuss more details at the café on the 3rd.

Later on the 1st, Leo talks to Mei at the hospital, who expresses excitement for their double date with Samantha on the 8th. They discuss Leo's new melodies for their community garden collaboration and agree to regroup at the café the following Saturday at 2 PM.
